purpose: Treat the 5,184-bit HFC register as a recoverable leaf inside the complete 50,388,480-bit hydration, compress declared lattice-generated full states, and reconstruct physically missing encoded shards from independently persisted parity bytes.

strict_compression_domain.name: P212_AFFINE_9720_LEAF_SEEDS_PLUS_SPARSE_XOR_V1
strict_compression_domain.exception_encoding: strictly increasing full-hydration bit positions encoded as canonical ULEB128 gaps
strict_compression_domain.claim_rule: Strict compression is claimed only when the complete encoded payload is smaller than the 6,298,560-byte raw full hydration.

invariants.P212-I1: The complete hydration is exactly 40*243*5184 = 50,388,480 bits; 5,184 bits is a local leaf, never the total envelope.
invariants.P212-I2: Every local leaf is exactly 648 packed bytes and has one stable lane/control coordinate.
invariants.P212-I3: The strict affine domain stores exactly two seed bits for each of 9,720 leaves plus exact sparse XOR exceptions.
invariants.P212-I4: Arbitrary full states that do not become smaller use raw packed fallback and are protected without being described as compressed.
invariants.P212-I5: Every protected stripe contains up to 243 ordered data shards and two independently materialized parity shards.
invariants.P212-I6: Any two missing physical shards in one stripe are exactly reconstructable; three missing shards in one stripe fail closed.
invariants.P212-I7: Recovered data and parity bytes must match their retained Hash216 identities before decompression.
invariants.P212-I8: The decoded full state must match its state Hash216, all 40 lane roots, the full hydration root, package root, and Hash72 receipt.
invariants.P212-I9: No hash-only record is represented as recovery data; physical recovery requires surviving parity or generator bytes.
invariants.P212-I10: Canonical identity uses exact bytes and integer dimensions only; floating point is not admitted.
